what.text: This page follows refugees from Somalia living in Ireland, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3281 Somali refugees in Ireland, 0.4% of all refugees from Somalia.
Kenya and Ethiopia host the most Somali refugees, followed by Uganda and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Somalia in periods from 1994 to 2025, with Al-Shabaab among the opponents since 2006.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Somalia from 2019 to 2021 and in 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1999 at 141 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Ireland.
These are year-end totals for Ireland only, reported to UNHCR.
